name: agent-crew
description: Run a crew of Claude Code worker sessions under one coordinator: start and retire them in cmux panels, clear a worker's context between tasks without losing its identity, write task briefs that survive a context wipe, and verify what comes back instead of taking a worker's word for it. Turns a decided plan into tracker items a fresh session can start, ordered by dependency and confirmed before anything is created. Ships three worker roles — a backend developer, a read-only tester, and a solution architect that shapes the work before anyone implements it.
